nativeWorkerChange: Development-only palette whitelist admits all legal1/2/4/8 depths; timed native PAL8 expansion/conversion/output boundary unchanged. No production native dependency.

receiptRasterRecipeErratum.correctedRasterRecipe: Original RGBA8 red top2bits: j=red>>6,i=j*85; palette R=i,G=255-i,B=(73*i+19)%256,A=i,4 entries; depth2 indices MSB-first,unused low bits zero.
receiptRasterRecipeErratum.reason: Original receipt prose assumed other coded depths. Exact input/raster hashes,pixels,reported timing and allocation samples remain valid; original raw receipts are retained unchanged. Future WarmPng receipts use the general depth-aware quantizer description.
